Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.

2047-6465.description:
During your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Follow Him either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at most {8}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, creating that many Clue tokens.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

413-2018--73.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
If the creature entered the battlefield in step 3, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
If the creature entered the battlefield in step 5, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-2018--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

1308-2178-4660-5676.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
1308-2178-4660-5676.notablePrerequisites: Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
1308-2178-4660-5676.description:
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating two 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Fish.
When the Fish dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Fish trigger, creating two 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 6, dealing damage equal to the FIsh's power to any target.
Repeat from step 6 using the other Fish token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Whale.
When the Whale dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Whale trigger, creating two 9/9 Kraken creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 12, dealing damage equal to the Whale's power to any target.
Repeat from step 12 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 18, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 18 for each other Kraken token.

2292-2493-2596-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2292-2493-2596-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Great Whale, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Great Whale enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.
